# Clerk Design System

## 1. Visual Theme & Atmosphere

Enterprise-developer aesthetic with alternating light and dark section bands.
Typography-led hero and section intros, supported by product UI mockups and systems-style illustrations.
Angular/notched section separators and persistent rounded top navigation create a continuous, signature rhythm.

### Key Characteristics
- High contrast between light (#FFF / #F7F7F8) and dark (#131316 / #2F3037 / #0A0A0A) surfaces.
- Accent colors are sparse and semantic in use (purple and cyan-like moments) to label section categories and CTAs.
- Cards are heavily rounded with subtle outlines; dark cards use low-contrast illustration overlays.
- Visual storytelling prioritizes implementation clarity (auth forms, org management, billing tables, framework grids).
- Consistent floating circular support action anchored bottom-right across sections.

## 2. Color Palette & Roles

Neutral-first system with restrained accent color. Most hierarchy is driven by surface contrast, typographic scale, and spacing rather than saturated fills.

### Core neutrals
| Hex | Role | Where seen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#FFF` | primary light surface / base canvas | Hero, light sections, cards, nav shell |
| `#F7F7F8` | secondary light background | Light thematic bands and soft section backdrops |
| `#131316` | primary dark background | Dark authentication/features bands |
| `#2F3037` | elevated dark surface | Dark cards and layered panels |
| `#0A0A0A` | deep contrast neutral | Dark UI elements, high-emphasis controls/text |

### Accent and categorization
| Hex | Role | Where seen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#6C47FF` | section label accent (purple 500) | Category labels like components/auth/multi-tenancy/billing/integrations |
| `#6504FF` | high-chroma purple function accent | Occasional highlighted UI/code-adjacent moments |
| `#0062C0` | cool informational accent | Code/syntax-token contexts |
| `#007232` | success/link-like accent | Tokenized link/string contexts |

### Borders, overlays, and separators
| Hex | Role | Where seen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#1313161A` | light-surface border | Card/container outlines on light sections |
| `#FFFFFF1A` | dark-surface border | Dividers and borders in dark bands |
| `#ECECEE` | light divider | Logo strip and grid separators on light surfaces |
| `#0000000F` | subtle overlay/border | Soft borders and translucent overlays |
| `#0000001A` | stronger subtle border | Higher-contrast light-theme borders |
| `#00000026` | shadow tint | Drop shadow token for elevated elements |

### Notes
All hex values are sourced from extracted tokens; no additional colors introduced.

## 3. Typography Rules

Sans-serif dominant system (geistSans/Inter/suisse stack behavior) with mono support for code-like snippets. Visual style emphasizes large, bold marketing headlines while body remains readable and neutral.

### Hierarchy
| Role | Font | Size | Weight | Line height | Letter spacing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Body | geistSans, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif | 16px | 400 | 1.5 | normal |
| Body | geistSans, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif | var(--text-base) | 400 | var(--text-base--line-height) | normal |
| H1 | geistSans, Inter, suisse, ui-sans-serif | var(--text-3xl) | var(--font-weight-semibold) | var(--text-3xl--line-height) | -.015em |
| H2 | geistSans, Inter, suisse, ui-sans-serif | var(--text-2xl) | var(--font-weight-semibold) | var(--text-2xl--line-height) | var(--tracking-tight) |
| Small | geistSans, Inter, ui-sans-serif | 80% | 400 | normal | normal |
| Mono | geistMono, soehneMono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, Liberation Mono, Courier New, monospace | 16px | 400 | normal | normal |
| Mono | geistMono, soehneMono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, Liberation Mono, Courier New, monospace | 1em | 400 | normal | normal |

### Principles
- Keep marketing copy sans-serif and heavy in headings; reserve mono for code literals and command-like snippets.
- Use accent labels as smaller pre-head text blocks before major section headlines.
- Rely on weight and spacing changes more than color changes for hierarchy within cards and split layouts.

## 4. Component Stylings

### Buttons
- **Primary dark CTA** — background: #2F3037 or #0A0A0A; text: #FFF; border: 1px solid #00000014 or transparent (#0000) depending context; radius: var(--cb-button-radius,.375rem) / .375rem / var(--radius-lg); padding: Uses component-specific spacing tokens; base control height examples include 32px and 56px contexts; hover: Subtle contrast/elevation shift; no explicit transition duration token provided
- **Secondary light/outlined button** — background: #FFF; text: #131316; border: 1px solid #1313161A or #ECECEE; radius: var(--radius-lg) / .5rem / .625rem contexts; padding: Compact inline CTA sizing with utility spacing tokens; hover: Border/density emphasis increase without dramatic motion
- **Pill/tag action** — background: #FFF or #2F3037; text: #131316 or #FFF; border: 1px solid #0000000F or #FFFFFF1A; radius: 999px / 50px / 56px / 3.40282e38px (.!rounded-full); padding: Tight horizontal pill spacing; hover: Minor tonal shift, consistent with low-motion system

### Cards
Card-heavy system across both themes: light cards with soft borders and subtle shadows; dark cards with faint gradients/illustrative overlays and low-contrast outlines.
- Backgrounds: #FFF, #F7F7F8, #2F3037, #131316
- Borders: #1313161A, #FFFFFF1A, #ECECEE, #0000000F
- Radii in frequent use: var(--radius-xl), var(--radius-2xl), var(--radius-3xl), 12px, 15px, 20px, 22px

### Inputs
Form controls are straightforward, rectangular-to-soft-rounded fields with restrained borders, often paired with dark primary submit actions.
- Default form bg token supports #0000 baseline; surfaced input containers appear on #FFF
- Border colors: #1313161A / #00000014
- Radii include 0 (native reset) plus var(--cb-field-radius), var(--radius-md), .375rem

### Navigation
Persistent top navigation in a rounded container with thin border and subtle elevation; content remains horizontally distributed across product/docs/company/pricing and auth links.
- Nav surface: #FFF in light sections, darkened/translucent treatment over dark sections
- Border: subtle using #1313161A or #FFFFFF1A depending backdrop
- Rounded shell uses larger pill radius patterns (e.g., 50px / 999px / high round token styles)

### Image Treatment
Product UI mockups and abstract technical motifs dominate imagery. Dark sections use atmospheric glows and circuit-like linework; light sections favor crisp, low-noise UI cards.
- Dark atmospheric overlays: #FFFFFF0D on #2F3037 gradients
- Light wash overlays: #00000005 with #FFF
- Shadow tint token: #00000026

### Distinctive
- **Angled section separators** — Major transitions between light and dark blocks use notched/angled cut geometry instead of flat horizontal breaks.
- **Accordion + foreground auth modal composition** — Components section pairs a left textual accordion with a right, elevated sign-up modal mockup layered over muted background UI.
- **Framework/Integration icon grids** — Two-column dark section uses large bordered grid matrices for ecosystem logos, reinforcing platform breadth.

## 5. Layout Principles

### Spacing Scale
Token set is highly granular and utility-driven, including micro and large offsets. Notable recurring values include 1px, 2px, 4px, 12px, 20px, 30px, 32px, 56px, 90px, 1rem, 1.5rem, 2rem, 3rem, 4rem, 5rem, 6rem, 7.5rem, 8.75rem, 10rem, 12rem, 16rem, 24rem, 32rem, 40rem, 50rem, plus negative layout offsets such as -2.0625rem, -4.5rem, -6.25rem, -6.75rem, -8.75rem, -9rem, -10rem, -10.75rem, -12.75rem, -14.1875rem, -18.6875rem, -18.75rem, -21.25rem, -29rem, -50rem.

### Grid
Desktop-first centered container with repeated two-column section structures and asymmetric card grids; logo strips and integration/framework matrices use evenly divided columns with visible separators.

### Whitespace
Large vertical section padding establishes rhythm; internal spacing is tighter and consistent between label, headline, body, and CTA.

### Radius Scale
Named core radii: xs .125rem, sm .25rem, md .375rem, lg .5rem, xl .75rem, 2xl 1rem, 3xl 1.5rem, 4xl 2rem. Additional explicit radii include 0, .2em, .3rem, .5px, .09rem, .14rem, .15rem, .17rem, .21rem, .26rem, .31rem, .33rem, .34rem, .44rem, .52rem, .625rem, .723rem, .875rem, 1.25rem, 1.375rem, 1.1875rem, 2.25rem, 2.5rem, 2.6875rem, 2.8125rem, 3px, 4px, 5px, 6px, 12px, 15px, 20px, 22px, 50px, 56px, 50%, 100%, 999px, 3.40282e38px, and variable/calc forms (e.g., var(--cb-button-radius), var(--cb-field-radius), var(--clerk-modal-radius), calc(var(--radius-lg) + .25rem)).

## 6. Depth & Elevation

### Levels
| Level | Use | Shadow |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Flat | Base page backgrounds and large section planes | `0 0 #0000` |
| Low | Outlined cards and nav shell | `0 1px 2px #00000026` |
| Medium | Foreground mockups (auth modal, pricing card) and floating controls | `0 1px 2px #00000026 + soft ambient glows from layered gradients` |

### Philosophy
Depth is subtle and contrast-led: borders + tonal layering do most of the work, with minimal hard shadows and occasional atmospheric glow fields.

## 7. Interaction & Motion

### Hover States
CTAs and nav links signal interactivity via tiny arrow/chevron motifs, slight contrast shifts, and underline/weight emphasis patterns rather than large transforms.

### Focus States
Form-centric UI indicates standard focus affordance through border/ring behavior; ring offset token is present with #FFF and 0px offset width.

### Transitions
No explicit transition duration/easing values were provided in the supplied CSS facts digest; use minimal-motion state changes unless additional motion tokens are introduced.

## 8. Responsive Behavior

### Breakpoints
| Name | Min width | Primary changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bp-1 | 40em | Initial layout expansion; increased horizontal room for nav/content grouping. |
| bp-2 | 48em | Two-column section compositions become stable and more frequent. |
| bp-3 | 64em | Desktop-default marketing layout with wide split sections and card grids. |
| bp-4 | 80em | Larger container presentation, increased whitespace and mockup prominence. |
| bp-5 | 96em | Max-width comfort zone for full-feature grids and long-form section pacing. |

### Touch Targets
Control heights seen include 32px and 56px tokens; keep interactive targets at or above these established component heights where possible.

### Collapsing Strategy
Section modules are built to stack from split columns to single-column flows while preserving label→headline→body→CTA order and card hierarchy.

### Image Behavior
Mockups and illustration panels should scale within cards/containers, maintaining rounded clipping and preserving foreground emphasis against soft background glows.

## 9. Agent Prompt Guide

### Quick Color Reference
```text
Light base: #FFF, #F7F7F8
Dark base: #131316, #2F3037, #0A0A0A
Primary accent purple: #6C47FF
Support accents: #0062C0, #007232
Light borders: #1313161A, #ECECEE, #0000000F
Dark borders: #FFFFFF1A
```

### Example Prompts
- Build a two-theme marketing section that alternates #FFF and #131316 backgrounds with an angled separator between them.
- Create a rounded top nav shell with subtle border (#1313161A on light / #FFFFFF1A on dark), persistent across all page sections.
- Design a feature card grid using dark cards on #2F3037 with low-contrast illustration overlays and heading-first hierarchy.

### Iteration Guide
- Lock colors to tokenized hex values only; do not introduce non-token colors.
- When setting type, copy size/weight/line-height/letter-spacing exactly from provided hierarchy tokens.
- Use named radii tokens first (xs→4xl), then apply explicit px/rem radii only where component fidelity needs it.
- Preserve the hallmark Clerk rhythm: large typographic intros, practical UI mockups, alternating light/dark bands, and notched transitions.

# Convex Design System

## 1. Visual Theme & Atmosphere

High-contrast, developer-centric aesthetic with alternating dark and light section bands.
Confident, performance-forward tone: oversized sans headlines, dense product proof, and repeated terminal/demo motifs.
Rounded, pill-heavy component language (buttons, tags, cards, chips) creates a cohesive UI signature.
Editorial contrast appears via selective serif italic moments (quotes, enterprise flourish) against utilitarian sans UI text.

### Key Characteristics
- Alternating sectional backgrounds (dark hero/components/footer, cream proof area, olive testimonial, maroon founder/enterprise).
- Persistent header with contrast-adaptive foreground and pill CTAs.
- Terminal-style demo panels reused as top/bottom bookends.
- Outlined micro-pill section labels (e.g., TRUSTED BY, BUILT FOR THE FRONTIER, QUOTES).
- Subtle texture/grid overlays to add depth without heavy illustration.

## 2. Color Palette & Roles

Use a dark-neutral foundation with one light cream surface for contrast-heavy proof content. Preserve restrained accent usage and rely on tonal shifts, translucency, and borders for hierarchy.

### Core dark neutrals
| Hex | Role | Where seen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#000` | Primary dark text/surface anchor | Footer, dark sections, iconography |
| `#111` | Near-black surface tone | Hero/components/founder backgrounds (tonal family) |
| `#141414` | Dark elevated card/surface tone | Component cards, dark containers |
| `#292929` | Secondary dark neutral | Dark chips, elevated rows |

### Light and contrast surfaces
| Hex | Role | Where seen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#FFF` | Primary inverse text / light fill | Headlines/buttons on dark sections |
| `#EBE3D1` | Cream section background | Trusted logos and Solved section |
| `#FFFC` | Translucent light overlay | Soft overlays/modals |

### Borders and separators
| Hex | Role | Where seen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#FFF3` | Light border on dark surfaces | Outlined pills and subtle dark-section borders |
| `#0000000D` | Hairline border/shadow tint | Light-section row dividers, subtle outlines |
| `#14141426` | Muted divider | List/table separators |
| `#F6EEDB33` | Warm light border | Borders on dark/warm themed blocks |
| `#F6EEDB1A` | Very subtle warm divider | Low-contrast section/card dividers |

### Depth/shadow colors
| Hex | Role | Where seen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#0000001A` | Medium shadow color | Card and floating element shadows |
| `#00000040` | Strong shadow color | Deeper elevation and header/drop shadows |
| `#00000021` | Long/far shadow tint | Large soft shadow stacks |
| `#00000012` | Soft shadow tint | Layered ambient shadows |
| `#0003` | Translucent dark overlay | Overlay backgrounds |

### Notes
Only token-extracted hex values are listed. Non-token visual accents (e.g., stripe motif colors) should be treated as image/illustration assets unless mapped to explicit tokens.

## 3. Typography Rules

Primary voice is sans (gtAmerica / system sans stack), with heavy display emphasis and selective serif italic contrast for quotes/enterprise callouts. Monospace is used for command/code rows.

### Hierarchy
| Role | Font | Size | Weight | Line height | Letter spacing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| H1 | gtAmerica, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, Noto Sans, sans-serif | 2.25em | 800 | 1.11111 | normal |
| H2 | gtAmerica, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, Noto Sans, sans-serif | 1.5em | 700 | 1.33333 | normal |
| Body | gtAmerica, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, Noto Sans, sans-serif | 1.25em | 400 | 1.6 | normal |
| Body | gtAmerica, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, Noto Sans, sans-serif | 16px | 400 | 1.5 | normal |
| Body | gtAmerica | 16px | 400 | normal | normal |
| Small | gtAmerica, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, Noto Sans, sans-serif | 80% | 400 | normal | normal |
| Body | gtAmerica, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, Noto Sans, sans-serif | 75% | 400 | 0 | normal |
| Mono | IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, Liberation Mono, Courier New, monospace | 16px | 400 | normal | normal |
| Mono | IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, Liberation Mono, Courier New, monospace | 1em | 400 | normal | normal |
| Body | inherit | var(--wa-banner-font-size,1rem) | 400 | 1.25 | normal |
| Body | inherit | var(--wa-banner-button-font-size,inherit) | var(--wa-banner-button-font-weight,inherit) | 1 | normal |
| H1 | inherit | inherit | inherit | normal | normal |

### Principles
- Use heavyweight sans for primary marketing claims and product positioning.
- Use monospace for actionable developer snippets and install commands.
- Reserve serif styling for high-emotion/value moments (quote and enterprise phrase) to create intentional contrast.
- Keep letter-spacing at normal across core scale per tokens.

## 4. Component Stylings

### Buttons
- **Primary pill CTA** — background: #FFF (or dark inversion depending section context); text: #000 / #111; border: 1px solid #0000 or subtle dark border usage; radius: 3.40282e38px (rounded-full); also 9999px in wa-banner button token; padding: .5rem .75rem (wa-banner button token); hover: Dark-surface hover tint uses #211414 where applicable; additional hover shadows exist in token set.
- **Secondary outlined pill** — background: #0000; text: #FFF on dark / #000 on light; border: 1px solid #FFF3 or #0000000D depending surface; radius: var(--radius-xl), var(--radius-2xl), or rounded-full (tokenized rounded usage); padding: .5rem .75rem or 1rem-scale horizontal spacing patterns; hover: Group/hover dark tint tokens include #2929291A and #2929290D backgrounds.

### Cards
Rounded dark cards with subtle contrast separation; include small outlined tag, bold title, supportive copy, and terminal-style action row.
- Background families: #141414 / #292929 on dark sections
- Borders: #FFF3 (dark) or #0000000D/#14141426 (light contexts)
- Radii: var(--radius-2xl), var(--radius-3xl), 1.25rem, 20px, 22px, 32px (observed utility set)
- Shadows: shadow-md and custom tw shadow stacks (e.g., 0px 8px 4px ... , 0px 91px 50px ...)

### Inputs
Input-like prompt rows are treated as terminal strips: dark fills, light text, icon affordances, and rounded edges.
- Background: #292929 and #0003 overlays
- Border: #FFF3 or #0000000D depending section
- Radius: .375rem, var(--radius-lg), var(--radius-xl), calc(.75rem - 1px)
- Mono text: 16px / 1em at weight 400

### Navigation
Sticky-looking top bar with wordmark left, link cluster center, utility icons + auth/build CTAs right. Contrast flips per section background.
- Header height token: 80px
- Pill/circle controls use rounded-full / large radii
- Light/dark inversion via #FFF and dark neutrals (#111/#141414/#292929)
- Subtle shadow usage available via shadow-header token

### Image Treatment
Imagery is sparse and functional: logos, founder portraits, and UI screenshots; decorative texture/grid overlays provide atmosphere.
- Grain/overlay support via transparent colors (#0003, #FFFC)
- Borders/dividers in #F6EEDB33, #14141426
- Shadow accents from #00000012/#00000021 stacks

### Distinctive
- **Bookend demo panels** — Near-identical terminal demo modules appear in hero and near-footer CTA to reinforce product mental model.
- **Outlined micro-pill labels** — Section landmarks in tiny outlined capsules establish navigation rhythm across alternating bands.
- **Alternating sectional palette blocks** — Strong horizontal blocks (dark, cream, olive, maroon) create clear narrative phases from proof to credibility to conversion.

## 5. Layout Principles

### Spacing Scale
Token spacing includes: -1px, 1px, 2px, 3px, 4px, .1875em, .375em, .5em, .5rem, .571429em, .75em, .75rem, .857143em, 1em, 1rem, 1.14286em, 1.2em, 1.25em, 1.6em, 1.625em, 1.71429em, 2em, 2vw, 3em, 40px, 80px, 24rem, 600px, 1536px, 100vh, 100vw.

### Grid
Centered max-width layout with large horizontal gutters; repeated multi-column zones (logo rows, testimonial cards, founder bios, footer 4-column sitemap). Visual motifs include light and dark graph-paper grids.

### Whitespace
Generous section padding and breathing room between headline, support copy, and action modules; consistent vertical rhythm between stacked cards and chips.

### Radius Scale
var(--wa-banner-border-radius,0), var(--wa-banner-button-border-radius,0), .25rem (radius sm), .375rem (radius md), .5rem (radius lg), .75rem (radius xl), 1rem (radius 2xl), 1.5rem (radius 3xl), 2rem (radius 4xl), 0, var(--radius-lg), 9999px, inherit, .3125rem, var(--radius-2xl), var(--radius-3xl), var(--radius-4xl), 1.25rem, 3px, 4px, 9px, 11px, 13px, 15px, 20px, 22px, 32px, calc(.75rem - 1px), 3.40282e38px, var(--radius-md), var(--radius-sm), var(--radius-xl), plus directional radii tokens (top/left/right/bottom variants including 0).

## 6. Depth & Elevation

### Levels
| Level | Use | Shadow |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base | Large section backgrounds and flat bands | `none / 0 0 #0000 token defaults` |
| Raised cards | Feature cards, testimonial cards, integration chips | `0 4px 6px -1px #0000001a, 0 2px 4px -2px #0000001a (shadow-md) and related tw shadow variants` |
| Floating overlays | Cookie modal, prominent panels, header emphasis | `Multi-stop custom shadows (e.g., 0px 8px 4px var(--tw-shadow-color,#00000012), 0px 91px 50px var(--tw-shadow-color,#00000021))` |

### Philosophy
Depth is subtle and layered: mostly tonal contrast + rounded boundaries, with selective soft shadow stacks for interactive/floating elements.

## 7. Interaction & Motion

### Hover States
Hover affordances rely on tint shifts and shadow elevation (e.g., #211414 hover background, #2929291A group hover background, hover shadow tokens). Arrows/copy icons reinforce clickability.

### Focus States
Focusable controls use explicit focus-visible ring/shadow composition: outline 2px solid #0000 plus ring shadow formulas with calc(2px + var(--tw-ring-offset-width)) and ring-offset shadow tokens.

### Transitions
No explicit transition-duration/easing values were provided in the supplied CSS facts digest; do not invent timing values.

## 8. Responsive Behavior

### Breakpoints
| Name | Min width | Primary changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bp-1 | 40rem | Progressive enhancement from compact stacking toward wider multi-column composition. |
| bp-2 | 64rem | Desktop-grade spacing expansion and fuller hero/component layouts. |
| bp-4 | 48rem | Mid-layout reflow for cards/chips and typography spacing adjustments. |
| bp-6 | 80rem | Larger container behavior and increased horizontal breathing room. |
| bp-7 | 96rem | Ultra-wide refinement for max-width regions and footer/section spread. |
| bp-8 | 400px | Early small-screen adjustments for controls/banner sizing. |

### Touch Targets
Pill buttons and icon circles are visually large and finger-friendly; rounded-full controls support tap precision.

### Collapsing Strategy
Content collapses from multi-column to stacked card flows while preserving section order and repeated CTA anchors.

### Image Behavior
Logos/headshots remain contained within rounded/circular frames; decorative textures and grids scale as background treatments rather than focal media.

## 9. Agent Prompt Guide

### Quick Color Reference
```text
Dark base: #000 / #111 / #141414 / #292929
Light base: #FFF and #EBE3D1
Dark-on-light border: #0000000D / #14141426
Light-on-dark border: #FFF3 / #F6EEDB33
Shadow tints: #0000001A, #00000012, #00000021, #00000040
Transparent overlays: #0000, #0003, #FFFC
```

### Example Prompts
- Create a Convex-style hero with a #111 background, oversized sans headline, and a rounded terminal panel using mono 16px text and #FFF3 borders.
- Build a cream proof section on #EBE3D1 with outlined pill label, logo row, and checklist table divided by #0000000D borders.
- Design a dark feature-card stack using #141414/#292929 surfaces, rounded-2xl/3xl corners, and subtle shadow-md elevation.

### Iteration Guide
- Start with section banding and container rhythm before component detail.
- Apply typography strictly from token hierarchy (no inferred font sizes).
- Use rounded pills/cards per radius token set; prefer var(--radius-*) utilities first.
- Add depth conservatively with existing shadow tokens; avoid new shadow formulas.
- Validate every palette hex against token list before final handoff.

# Figma Design System

## 1. Visual Theme & Atmosphere

Minimal, high-contrast editorial shell: predominantly #FFFFFF backgrounds with strong #000000 typography and CTAs.
Framed viewport behavior with persistent top header and sticky bottom announcement bar creates a constant chrome around long-scroll content.
Creative-product identity is expressed through intermittent saturated media blocks (collage, demo canvas, image mosaic) separated by generous whitespace.

### Key Characteristics
- Left-aligned, text-first hierarchy with oversized headlines and restrained supporting copy.
- Monochrome UI controls (black buttons, white text, subtle border dividers) contrasted by bright in-content visuals.
- Rounded geometry used consistently across buttons, cards, and media overlays.
- Sparse rhythm: dense showcase moments punctuate long blank intervals.
- Utility-forward interaction language: underlined text links, clear CTA buttons, simple iconography (menu, close, pause, cursor motifs).

## 2. Color Palette & Roles

Base interface relies on strict black/white contrast for clarity and brand confidence, with a small set of tokenized accents and surface colors reserved for states, demos, and highlights.

### Core UI
| Hex | Role | Where seen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#FFFFFF` | Primary page/background and button foreground on dark CTAs | Global page canvas, header background, CTA text |
| `#000000` | Primary foreground, button background, borders/shadows source | Headlines, body text, header CTA, hero CTA, divider/shadow system |

### Accent & Surface
| Hex | Role | Where seen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#E4FF97` | Focus/background accent token | Focus-visible background token |
| `#00B6FF` | Decorative surface accent | Gradient/conic decorative background token |

### Semantic Error
| Hex | Role | Where seen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#972121` | Error background (light theme token) | Form error background token |
| `#FFB3B3` | Error background (dark theme token) | Form error background token |
| `#FFFFFF` | Error foreground (light theme token) | Form error foreground token |
| `#000000` | Error foreground (dark theme token) | Form error foreground token |

### Notes
Only token-present hex values are used. Visible sticky green promo bar appears in imagery but is not present as a deterministic hex token in the extracted color set.

## 3. Typography Rules

Sans-led system typography (figmaSans stack with SF Pro Display/system fallbacks) with mono support for code contexts. Hierarchy is created primarily through scale and placement rather than decorative treatments.

### Hierarchy
| Role | Font | Size | Weight | Line height | Letter spacing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| H1 | figmaSans, figmaSans Fallback, SF Pro Display, system-ui, helvetica, sans-serif | 2em | 400 | normal | normal |
| Body | figmaSans, figmaSans Fallback, SF Pro Display, system-ui, helvetica, sans-serif | 16px | 320 | normal | normal |
| Body | var(--global-font-sans, 'figmaSans', 'figmaSans Fallback', SF Pro Display, system-ui, helvetica, sans-serif) | 16px | 400 | 1.45 | normal |

# Stripe Design System

## 1. Visual Theme & Atmosphere

Clean, high-trust fintech marketing system with bright gradient energy over a restrained neutral base.
Modular storytelling rhythm: bold headline, card grids, proof metrics/case studies, then deep technical band.
Light surfaces dominate; dark navy sections are used as deliberate contrast resets for developer/infrastructure narratives.

### Key Characteristics
- Large editorial-style type blocks with mixed-emphasis color within single headlines.
- Rounded cards and utility icon chips reused across product modules.
- Purple brand actions are persistent across light and dark contexts.
- Frequent abstract gradient visuals (orange/pink/purple/blue) paired with practical UI mockups and data visuals.
- Strong enterprise credibility cues: metrics, logos, named case studies, and implementation pathways.

## 2. Color Palette & Roles

Use deep neutrals for trust and readability, reserve brand purple for action and key emphasis, and deploy vivid gradient colors as sectional attention anchors.

### Core neutrals

### Notes
All listed hex values are constrained to extracted tokens.

## 3. Typography Rules

System uses a display face via var(--hds-font-family) and system sans stack for body/UI. Hierarchy is driven by variable tokens and contextual size switching rather than many fixed pixel headings.

### Hierarchy
| Role | Font | Size | Weight | Line height | Letter spacing |

### Principles
- Keep long-form marketing headlines in display family with color-based emphasis shifts rather than weight jumps.
- Use system sans for body, nav, and utility UI for crisp cross-platform rendering.
- Prefer tokenized type sizes (var(--hds-...)) where available to preserve localization/flex behavior.

## 4. Component Stylings

### Buttons
- **Primary CTA** — background: #533AFD; text: #FFF; border: 1px solid #96F; radius: var(--hds-space-button-radius-lg); padding: --hds-button-padding-block-start: 15.5px; --hds-button-padding-block-end: 16.5px; hover: Color/contrast-led emphasis; maintain filled brand treatment
- **Secondary / outline** — background: #FFF; text: #061B31; border: 1px solid #D8DEE4; radius: var(--hds-space-button-radius-lg); padding: --hds-button-padding-block-start: 15.5px; --hds-button-padding-block-end: 16.5px; hover: Subtle border/contrast increase
- **Icon square utility** — background: #FFF; text: #533AFD; border: 1px solid #E7ECF1; radius: var(--hds-space-core-radius-sm); padding: 10px; hover: Tinted background cue with preserved icon contrast

### Cards
Primary module is a rounded, light card system for product stories, case studies, and editorial units; many cards include top-right square action icon and gradient/image media.
- card radius=var(--hds-space-core-radius-md)
- card radius inner=5px
- border-radius=calc(var(--card-radius) - 1px)
- box-shadow: 0 15px 35px 0 hsla(0,0%,9%,.08)
- border: 1px solid #E7ECF1

### Inputs
Recommendation module uses large bordered text area with supporting utility row, counter, and send control; focus styling is tokenized via canary/focus tokens.
- border: 1px solid #D8DEE4
- hds canary color border focus: #635BFF
- hds space input focus shadowOuter: 3px
- hds space input focus shadowSingle: 2px
- border-radius=var(--hds-space-core-radius-md)

### Navigation
Top horizontal nav with text links, subtle dividers, and dual CTA cluster. Dropdown surfaces use strong layered shadows and controlled radii.
- --navigation-height: 76px
- border-bottom: 1px dashed #E5EDF5
- hds-navigation-menu__popup box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.1),0 30px 45px -30px rgba(50,50,93,.25)
- navigation border radius=var(--hds-space-core-radius-md)

### Image Treatment
Hybrid treatment mixing abstract gradients, product UI composites, photography, and technical diagrams. Light sections emphasize clarity; dark sections emphasize depth and systems complexity.
- Gradient anchors: #FF6118, #EA2261, #533AFD, #F96BEE, #FD6252, #FFD601, #EE30FB
- Dark base: #0D1738
- Card background: #FFF

### Distinctive
- **Hero ribbon gradient intrusion** — Large multicolor sweep enters from right/top-right, creating motion against left-aligned copy block.
- **Top-right micro action chip on cards** — Repeated small square icon button motif creates consistent discoverability for deeper drill-ins.
- **Light-to-dark narrative pivot** — Developer/infrastructure section flips to deep navy with pale typography and purple signal nodes to mark technical depth.

## 5. Layout Principles

### Spacing Scale
Primary recurring spacing tokens include 0px, 1px, 2px, 3px, 3.2px, 4px, 5px, 6px, 8px, 10px, 12px, 14px, 16px, 20px, 24px, 28px, 32px, 40px, 44px, 48px, 60px, 76px (plus negative offsets like -1px, -2px, -3px, -4px, -16px, -20px, -24px, -30px, -40px for layered graphics).

### Grid
Centered content container with generous gutters; recurring two-column intro row followed by 3–4 column card grids and occasional full-width feature banners.

### Whitespace
Generous vertical section padding with clear visual resets between modules (background shift or divider line).

### Radius Scale
0 / 0px / 1px / 2px / 3px / 4px / 4.51px / 5px / 6px (var(--hds-space-core-radius-md)) / 8px / 10px / 16px / 20px / 30px / 32px / 36px / 50% / 100% / 100px / 1rem / 99999px / 999999px, plus token aliases: var(--hds-space-core-radius-xs|sm|md|lg|xl|none|round), var(--hds-space-button-radius-sm|lg), var(--navigation-border-radius).

## 6. Depth & Elevation

### Levels
| Level | Use | Shadow |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Flat | Large section backgrounds, baseline layout planes | `none` |
| Subtle | Default cards and light surfaces | `0 15px 35px 0 hsla(0,0%,9%,.08)` |
| Interactive/overlay | Navigation popups, elevated panels, tooltips | `0 18px 36px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.1),0 30px 45px -30px rgba(50,50,93,.25)` |

### Philosophy
Depth is sparing and functional: flat reading planes first, elevated cards second, and high-elevation overlays only for transient UI.

## 7. Interaction & Motion

### Hover States
CTAs and links rely on contrast/tint reinforcement; icon chips and outlined controls signal interactivity via border/background emphasis.

### Focus States
Focus uses brand/canary border color #635BFF with tokenized focus shadow sizes (3px outer, 2px single) where applicable.

### Transitions
No explicit transition/animation duration values were provided in the supplied CSS facts digest; do not invent timing values.

## 8. Responsive Behavior

### Breakpoints
| Name | Min width | Primary changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bp-189 | 480px | Small-screen to wider mobile adjustments for cards and controls. |
| bp-1 | 600px | Expanded spacing and component sizing. |
| bp-2 | 640px | Grid and content-width refinements. |
| bp-163 | 840px | Transition toward multi-column section layouts. |
| bp-3 | 940px | Desktop-like card grids and two-column narrative blocks. |
| bp-31 | 1051px | Wider desktop nav/content calibration. |
| bp-33 | 1264px | Large desktop container and denser horizontal composition. |
| bp-7 | 1300px | Maximized multi-column presentation and long-form module breathing room. |

### Touch Targets
Buttons observed at 40px and nav button group at 44px heights support tap-friendly controls.

### Collapsing Strategy
Narrative sections collapse from multi-column (2–4 cols) into single-column stacks while preserving CTA adjacency to section intros.

### Image Behavior
Hero and feature imagery scale to container with cropping in high-impact modules; gradients remain compositional anchors across breakpoints.

## 9. Agent Prompt Guide

### Quick Color Reference
```text
Primary action: #533AFD
Primary text/dark neutral: #061B31
Dark section base: #0D1738
Base light surface: #FFF
Key gradient stops: #FF6118, #EA2261, #F96BEE, #FD6252, #FFD601, #EE30FB, #7232F1

```

### Example Prompts
- Build a Stripe-like hero with left-aligned H1, eyebrow stat, two CTAs, and a right-side gradient ribbon using #FF6118/#EA2261/#533AFD on #FFF.
- Create a 3-column product card grid with white cards, subtle borders (#E7ECF1), radius var(--hds-space-core-radius-md), and purple utility icon chips.
- Design a dark developer section on #0D1738 with pale text, purple node accents (#533AFD/#96F), and prominent metric blocks.

### Iteration Guide
- Start with light-section layout rhythm (intro row + card grid + proof row) before adding decorative gradients.
- Apply token radii and spacing exactly; keep card and button rounding consistent via var(--hds-space-core-radius-md) and var(--hds-space-button-radius-lg).
- Introduce dark-section pivot only at key narrative point to preserve contrast impact.
- Validate all interactive states: primary filled CTA, secondary outline CTA, focus ring using #635BFF-based token behavior.

# Supabase Design System

## 1. Visual Theme & Atmosphere

Minimal, developer-first SaaS aesthetic built on bright white space, thin gray separators, and crisp black typography.
Brand green is used surgically for primary actions and emphasized phrases, while most of the interface remains neutral.
Long-scroll narrative structure alternates dense product-card grids with open headline-led sections and social proof blocks.
Rounded geometry is consistent across cards, buttons, tabs, code panes, and mock windows, creating a coherent component language.

### Key Characteristics
- Sticky, compact top navigation with dual CTA pattern (primary filled + secondary outlined).
- Card-heavy product system with 1px hairline borders (#E3E3E3) and soft corner radii.
- UI-as-illustration approach (dashboard mockups, code windows, endpoint chips) instead of photography.
- Selective high-chroma moments (customer gradient/testimonial) to punctuate an otherwise neutral page.
- Trust-building sequence: logos → templates → stories → community quotes → open source + compliance strip.

## 2. Color Palette & Roles

Predominantly neutral UI surfaces with high legibility text; green operates as the brand/action accent. Strong non-brand colors appear only in isolated storytelling modules.

### Core neutrals
| Hex | Role | Where seen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#FFF` | Primary page and card background | Global background, cards, inputs, secondary buttons |
| `#000` | Primary text and icon color | Headlines, nav labels, core copy emphasis |

## 3. Typography Rules

### Hierarchy
| Role | Font | Size | Weight | Line height | Letter spacing |

### Principles
- Keep headline tone bold and concise, but maintain body and support copy in neutral-weight sans text.
- Use monospace only for code/terminal or developer artifact surfaces.
- Preserve strong contrast hierarchy: #000 for primary narrative, #525252/#575E61 for secondary explanation.
- Prefer compact microcopy and functional wording in controls, tabs, and CTA labels.

## 4. Component Stylings

### Buttons

- **Pill/tab button** — background: #FFF; text: #000 or #525252; border: 1px solid #E3E3E3; radius: 300px or rounded-full (3.40282e+38px) depending implementation; padding: .5rem and 1rem-scale spacing patterns; hover: Selected state uses stronger contrast and sometimes #0070F3 border accent

### Cards
Primary layout primitive: white cards with thin gray borders and medium-to-large rounded corners; used for product modules, template tiles, social proof cards, and framed UI demos.
- background: #FFF
- border: 1px solid #E3E3E3
- radius options seen: 14px, 20px, 24px, var(--radius-xl), var(--radius-2xl), var(--radius-3xl)
- shadow often none; selected media/code cards can use deep multi-layer shadow

### Inputs
Inputs are neutral, white-filled controls with subtle border language and ring-based focus utilities.
- background-color: #FFF
- border: 1px solid #E3E3E3
- padding: .5rem .75rem
- focus outline base: 2px solid #0000
- focus ring/outline accents include #00D29480 and #00D29499

### Navigation
Sticky top bar with logo, product/developer links, GitHub count, and paired CTA actions; visually separated by thin bottom divider.
- background: #FFF
- text: #000 with secondary labels in #525252
- divider/border: 1px solid #E3E3E3
- button radii align with 8px / var(--radius-md|lg) patterns

### Image Treatment
Little to no photography; visuals are product UI mockups, vector diagrams, code panes, brand logos, and social cards. Neutral frames with occasional bold gradient highlight block.
- framed modules use #FFF + #E3E3E3 borders
- dark code/terminal surfaces: #1E1E1E / #020405 / #060809
- decorative gradient token includes #DBB8BF
- accent highlights and dots leverage #3ECF8E

### Distinctive
- **Product capability card matrix** — Stacked grid of consistent rounded cards pairing concise copy with line-art or UI mini-scenes; creates modular platform story.
- **Developer window framing** — Dashboard and code sections are presented as faux app windows with titlebar controls, reinforcing hands-on tooling credibility.
- **Customer spotlight contrast block** — Single high-saturation testimonial panel breaks neutral rhythm to anchor social proof and narrative momentum.

## 5. Layout Principles

### Spacing Scale
Token set includes compact increments and utility extremes. Frequently reused values include 1px, 2px, 3px, 4px, 8px, 10px, 15px, 16px, 20px, 24px, 30px, 32px, 40px, 44px, 50px, 56px, 60px, 70px, 80px, 100px, 120px, 140px, 150px, 180px, 200px, 220px, 240px, 250px, 260px, 280px, 290px, 300px, 320px, 350px, 400px, 420px, 440px, 450px, 480px, 500px, 600px, 700px, 900px, plus rem/em utilities (.2rem, .25rem, .4rem, .5rem, .75rem, 1rem, 3rem, .1em, .2em, .375em, .5em, .75em, 1em, 1.2em, 1.25em, 1.4em, 1.5em, 1.6em, 1.625em, 2em, 3em) and negative offsets (-1px, -2px, -.15rem, -.5rem, -1rem, -70px, -160px).

### Grid
Centered main container with full-width section bands; desktop alternates single-column narrative blocks and 2-column card rows; dense multi-card mosaics used for templates and community quotes.

### Whitespace
Generous vertical separation between major sections; tighter internal spacing in nav, pills, and small cards to preserve information density.

### Radius Scale
0, 2px, 4px, 6px, 7px, 8px, 9px (corner-specific), 14px, 16.9281px, 20px, 24px, 300px, 50%, 100%, 3.40282e+38px, .25em, .5em, .125rem (xs), .25rem (sm), .3125rem, .375rem (md), .5rem (lg), .75rem (xl), 1rem (2xl), 1.5rem (3xl), plus tokenized forms var(--radius-xs|sm|md|lg|xl|2xl|3xl), var(--radius-md,.375rem), and inherit.

## 6. Depth & Elevation

### Levels
| Level | Use | Shadow |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Flat | Default page planes, most cards, and bordered modules | `none / 0 0 #0000 tokenized baseline` |
| Raised content modules | Code blocks, previews, spotlight panes | `0 13px 27px -5px rgba(50,50,93,.25),0 8px 16px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.3),0 -6px 16px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.025)` |

### Philosophy
Depth is restrained: borders do most separation work; shadows are selectively applied to interactive/demo artifacts for focus.

## 7. Interaction & Motion

### Collapsing Strategy

## 9. Agent Prompt Guide

# Vercel Design System

Minimal monochrome product-marketing aesthetic with strong black/white contrast.

Depth is minimal and functional; borders do most structural work, with shadows reserved for small emphasis moments.

## 7. Interaction & Motion

Clickable affordances are primarily signaled through pill shapes, borders, and cursor semantics; explicit hover CSS values were not provided in the digest.

### Collapsing Strategy
Progressive simplification from split columns to single-column stacks; screenshots remain primary anchors while side copy drops below/above as needed.

Large product screenshots scale within bordered containers and use fade masks to avoid abrupt clipping between sections.

## 9. Agent Prompt Guide

# WorkOS Design System

## 1. Visual Theme & Atmosphere

Enterprise SaaS marketing aesthetic with alternating light and dark section bands.
Strong typography-led hierarchy, with cool-spectrum accents (purple/blue/cyan) used for emphasis and CTAs.
Developer credibility is communicated through code panels, API language tabs, and systems-style diagrams.
Rounded component language is consistent across buttons, cards, logo tiles, mockups, and interactive affordances.

### Key Characteristics
- Alternating white/#FFF and deep dark surfaces (notably #181B39) to segment narrative chapters.
- Gradient-like brand expression anchored by #6363F1, #0082F3, #D272FF, and #23F0C3 accents.
- Dense social proof (logo wall) balanced by large whitespace and two-column explanatory sections.
- Technical-yet-approachable tone: modern APIs, enterprise controls, and polished admin UX visuals.
- Minimal chrome and restrained borders; hierarchy primarily comes from scale, color contrast, and shadow depth.

## 2. Color Palette & Roles

Cool, trust-oriented enterprise palette: neutral light backgrounds and dark technical surfaces, with purple/blue brand accents and cyan highlights for developer-focused actions.

### Core surfaces & text

All palette hexes are constrained to extracted tokens. Shadow alpha colors (e.g., #0000001A, #101A710A/#101A710F/#101A7114) are used for elevation and overlays.

## 3. Typography Rules

Primary voice uses Aeonik (400/500) for UI and marketing copy, with monospaced stacks (IBM Plex Mono/Andale Mono/Ubuntu Mono/monospace) for code-heavy sections. Typography is clean, low-ornament, and hierarchy-forward.

### Principles
- Use Aeonik as default interface and marketing typeface; reserve mono stack for code and payload examples.

## 4. Component Stylings
